note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. The gradient dial, its prints, the date window and the flange minute track stay in the dial map; the insert's silver prints are traced outlines built as inlays; the rubber strap uses the strap map.

review.subtitle: Tissot Seastar 1000 Powermatic 80, 43 mm, blue gradient dial, black ceramic insert, black rubber strap. Front relief GLB, round 1.
specs: lug to lug in the render
lug gap in the render (21 listed)
notes: Modelled: steel bezel with a 90-tooth coin edge, black ceramic insert with the silver triangle, numerals and minute marks as traced inlays, polished inner lip, applied indices with polished frames and lume (round dots, triangle at 12, bars at 3 and 9, short bar at 6), broad baton hour and minute hands with lume panels, polished seconds hand with a lume dot and T-shaped counterweight, fluted crown in its crown guard, brushed lugs, rubber strap with the house curl.

From the photo maps: blue gradient dial with TISSOT 1853, SEASTAR, POWERMATIC 80, 30 bar (300m / 1000 ft), SWISS MADE, the date window (8) and the black flange with its minute track; the rubber strap texture.
Under the hands and indices the dial is a smooth fill; it is covered by the 3D parts.
Scale is the official 43 mm case from Tissot's straight-on render (the supplied photo is 1024 px). Heights are a front-relief reading of the official 12.7 mm.
